claude.sample_unit: usable LLM responses (plus 1,128 clinician responses from 47 clinicians)

links.outcome: Lure diagnosis selection when a minor contextual cue was added to clinical cases, LLMs versus clinicians
links.effect: Baseline LLMs selected the lure in 84.9% of matched cue responses vs 27.8% for clinicians; extra cue effect 57.6 percentage points (95% CI 50.2-65.2); cue accuracy 12.4% vs 54.6%.
links.quote: Baseline LLMs selected the lure in 84.9% of matched cue responses versus 27.8% for clinician participants, an extra cue effect of 57.6 percentage points (95% CI 50.2-65.2); cue accuracy fell to 12.4% versus 54.6%.
